We are a data-driven organisation with a highly experienced team of more than 50 senior industry specialists, quantitative analysts, and software engineers. XTP is building an international culture where our team feels empowered, responsible, and valued. Synthesize your results in presentations and hold those in front of our clients and their asset managers. Increase the net return of our clients’ liquid assets by improving cost efficiency based on the results of your analysis. Develop new quantitative models and software tools to enhance process automation and to improve the handling of large amounts of trading and market data. Grow with us and take over more project responsibilities. Requirements Strong quantitative skills and high affinity to numbers – you believe that data analytics are cool. Strong academic background in mathematics, physics, or finance. Intrinsic motivation to tackle and solve complex quantitative issues. You consider precision as a principle, not as a burden. Self-driven, very well organized,

jobs.description: About Boltz Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible. Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes. We focus on two things: Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners. Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment. The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich. jobs.title: FPGA Engineer Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As an FPGA Engineer Intern on Harmattan AI’s compute module team, you will take camera aggregation from concept to real hardware for the first time. Our drones carry more cameras than a single processor can take in, and your job is to show how an FPGA can close that gap. You will own the work end to end, from first design to a demonstrator on the bench. Your results will set how cameras are connected in our next hardware generation. Responsibilities Integrate existing IP cores, write HDL wrappers, simulate and validate FPGA logic that merges multiple camera streams into one. Investigate the system’s limits in camera count, resolution and frame rate. Build the processor-side pipeline that splits the merged stream so each camera stays independently usable. Debug the full chain, from cables and connectors to FPGA logic and camera software on the processor. Deliver a complete demonstrator and documentation that guide our next hardware design. Candidate Requirements Final-year Master’s or engineering school student in electrical engineering, electronics or embedded systems. Previous hands-on experience with FPGAs and digital board design and debugging. Experience writing software that runs close to the hardware; embedded Linux is a plus. Ideally, previous exposure to video or camera interfaces. Hands-on in the lab and comfortable reworking wiring, connectors and test setups to get a system running.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
jobs.description: About the team Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk. What you'll do You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on. Day to day, that looks like: Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production Running what you build. jobs.title: Stagiair Journalistiek - Trouw
jobs.description: Wil je graag snel aan de slag in de journalistiek? Dan is deze stage op de redactie bij Trouw iets voor jou. Trouw bereikt dagelijks duizenden betrokken mensen met de verdiepende journalistiek via print en online via de nieuwssite, nieuwsapps en digitale krant. Doordeweeks gaat het om 316.000 lezers via print en op zaterdag om ruim 430.000 lezers via krant en magazine. Daarnaast bereikt Trouw ook nog eens 2,3 miljoen unieke digitale lezers per maand via web en app. Kom bij ons stagelopen en zie je eigen ideeën, verhalen en producties terug in print, op onze site of social media. Wat ga je doen Stagiair zijn bij Trouw betekent hard werken, maar ook zelfstandig meedraaien, veel schrijven en op pad gaan, meewerken aan de online promotie van je verhalen en je ontwikkelen als volwaardig lid van een redactie. Stages zijn mogelijk bij nieuwsredacties verslaggeverij/binnenland, buitenland/nieuwsdienst, sport en politiek maar ook bij de redacties religie & filosofie en duurzaamheid & economie. Trouw zorgt daarbij voor deskundige en intensieve begeleiding. Voor goede stagiaires zijn er ook na de stage ook mogelijkheden voor werk. Veel van onze stagiairs blijven na hun stage aan de redactie verbonden. Trouw vindt een diverse redactie belangrijk en streeft daarom naar een open werksfeer, waar ruimte is voor collega’s met verschillende achtergronden en opvattingen. Profiel Wat we van jou verwachten? Wij zoeken een creatief en journalistiek talent. Je weet wat er in de wereld speelt en vindt het leuk om op nieuws te jagen en mooie verhalen te maken. Je bent iemand die: een journalistieke opleiding volgt op HBO- of WO-niveau; HBO-studenten moeten eerst elders succesvol stage hebben gelopen, WO-studenten moet een master journalistiek volgen; goed kan communiceren; stevig in zijn schoenen staat; onderwerpen tot op de bodem wil uitzoeken; goed de weg weet in social media; foutloos schrijft; creatief bent in het bedenken van onderwerpen. Periode Wij nemen het hele jaar stagiairs aan.

jobs.description: About the team The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA. The role We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own ClickHouse's Go clients. You'll decide what the clients should do by talking to the developers who use them, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep Go expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: clickhouse-go and ch-go, and the collectors, pipelines, agents and tools that write millions of rows per second through your code. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, throughput, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap. Be the voice of ClickHouse for Go developers. Speak at GopherCon and Go meetups, and write the posts, tutorials and examples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from Go (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them. Own the Go clients and their ecosystem: clickhouse-go, ch-go, database/sql, releases and support. jobs.description: Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents Sage AI Labs · Munich · Full-time · [Remote] About us Sage AI Labs is building the infrastructure that lets AI agents transact on the open web. It is one of the few genuinely unsolved problems left in commerce, and whoever solves it sets the defaults everyone else builds on top of. The company was founded by Sebastian Thrun (founder of Google X and Waymo, Udacity) and is backed by leading venture and strategic investors. About the role We build agents that shop for you. They find products across the open web and complete the purchase end to end. Real carts, real payments, and real systems built to stop them. You would own that. Architecture, code, deploys, monitoring, and on-call for systems that transact around the clock, working directly with our CTO. What you'll own Our checkout agents. Frontier-model computer-use agents driving live checkouts at scale, plus the machinery that keeps them standing when the ground moves. Every retailer breaks differently and they change without warning. Your job is to make failure rare and recovery automatic. Ingestion at scale. Take product ingestion from hundreds of sources to thousands. The answer is not more hand-written code. It is infrastructure that generates, validates, and monitors itself. Search and ranking. Embedding-based retrieval, LLM query understanding, reranking, and caching, across a catalog that never stops changing. What we're looking for 5+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with strong Python You have owned production systems end to end: deploys, databases, observability, and the pager. You have been the person who got paged, and you fixed the class of problem rather than the incident You like adversarial problems. Systems where something on the other side is actively working against you You take correctness seriously because the stakes are real. jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role BFL’s research organization is split into different focus areas, such as pre-training, post-training, reinforcement learning, data, representation learning, evaluations and more. During the day to day work, researchers from these different focus areas work together to solve exciting and hard problems towards solving visual intelligence. Having the right means to measure what matters is the central starting point for every research project. Researchers make decisions based on the outcomes of evaluations. The right decision can only be made if an evaluation is precise and accurate. As the Evaluations Lead you’re the core driver to ensure that. Central responsibilities include building our eval roadmap in collaboration with the research and product teams, managing and extending our evaluation team, and cross-functional work with project leads to make sure each research project has the best evaluation toolbox to help the people working on it to make the right decisions. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we ve grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.  Information about the position Vinted is Europe s largest online C2C marketplace for second-hand fashion. jobs.description: About DataCamp Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors. In this role, you’ll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education .  About the role This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here s what your day-to-day will look like: Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines. Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors. Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content. Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale. Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective. Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements. jobs.description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE OPPORTUNITY Used cars are the biggest part of the UK car market, and Carwow is going all in. We already sit at the start of the used journey: through Sell My Car, dealers buy cars from Carwow sellers every day. But today that car leaves our platform the moment it’s bought. The dealer preps it, prices it and lists it somewhere else, and the buyer finds it somewhere else too. We want to close that loop. If every car a dealer buys can go live on Carwow in hours, priced to sell and matched to the buyers who want it, we become the place dealers source, retail and sell their used stock. jobs.description: If you became a nurse because you wanted to genuinely make a difference to patients lives, but you are ready to do it in a completely different way, this could be the role for you. We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives. This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey. It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life. What is the Role? This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants. This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient. jobs.title: Product Engineer (AI Team)
jobs.description: About Us Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before. We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever. The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of over 80 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London. AI is not a side project here. Jerry, our AI teammate for vets, launches this month with clinical decision support, a listening mode for live consults, and hands-free voice next. You will ship weekly to real clinics and see the impact directly. In this role, you will: Build Jerry's clinical guideline library: RAG over vet-approved guidelines using hybrid vector and keyword search in Postgres, so Jerry answers clinical questions only from approved sources and cites the exact lines it used Build Jerry's listening mode: a fast classifier that watches live consult transcripts and triggers Jerry to surface missed charges, tests, or risks in real time Build Jerry's voice mode: a hands-free, voice-first experience for ambulatory vets on the road, where everything is spoken and any change waits for the vet's approval Build long-running and scheduled Jerry tasks: turns that keep running after the vet closes the tab, and scheduled jobs that prepare drafts for the vet to approve Own what you build in production across the TypeScript server and Python AI service: deploys, monitoring, fixes, weekly releases, and a share of on-call Be a trusted reviewer on AI pull requests and write the design docs

At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. jobs.description: 1958, Fondasol réalise avec succès sa première mission géotechnique. Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 10 domaines d'expertise, le Groupe Fondasol est la référence en études et ingénierie conseil de la construction. Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets. Grâce à son actionnariat salarié majoritaire, le Groupe Fondasol continue de renforcer les synergies entre ses expertises, crée des outils digitaux innovants, décarbone ses activités… Autant dire qu'ici, passion de son métier, engagement, évolution… sont des évidences. En tant qu’ingénieur chargé d’affaires, vous accompagnez vos clients sur l’ensemble de leurs enjeux liés à la donnée du sous-sol, en solo ou en synergie avec les autres expertises du Groupe. Du terrain aux logiciels, vous maitrisez la chaine d’essais, savez mobiliser les datas disponibles et les méthodes et outils de calculs pour optimiser et adapter vos études aux besoins de vos clients. Prêt à relever ce défi passionnant qui conjugue expertise, relation client et innovation? Vos principales missions 1-Pilotage des opportunités et gestion de la relation client vous pilotez l'intégralité du cycle commercial : prises de contact, réponse aux appels d’offres et consultations directes. vous réalisez une analyse approfondie des besoins clients, identifiez et synthétisez les données disponibles. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? Join our Customer Experience Analytics team and help build the data foundation behind a better customer journey at Back Market. You'll be working with a crew of analysts to serve data-driven decisions across the customer experience. We collect trustworthy behavioural data, build analyses, and help teams use data in their day-to-day decisions. As a Customer Experience Analytics Engineer, you will turn messy data into reliable, scalable models that drive real business decisions. You'll partner closely with our customer journey, engagement and service team to make sure they can answer important questions about customer behaviour, engagement, retention and the impact of product and CRM initiatives. This role combines hands-on data modelling with a strong understanding of business needs. You will help define the metrics, datasets and tools that allow the Customer Experience teams to move quickly while keeping a high level of trust in the data. Your mission You will own and develop the analytics engineering foundations for the Customer Experience vertical. Build trusted data foundations Build, maintain and improve production-grade data models using dbt and BigQuery. jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expe

jobs.title: Country Executive
jobs.description: Country Executive The Finance Function Is Broken. Everyone Building For It Is Boring. Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job. Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week. What we don’t have yet is someone who owns each market as their own. We’re hiring Country Executives across several markets. Tell us which one is yours. This Is Not A Country Manager Role. Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else. No local playbook. You’ll be the person who owns your market, and within a year you should know its complexity (its rules, its buyers, its excuses) better than anyone else. It’s not a leadership title. It’s the seed of one. Do this right and there’s a real path: stand up an entity, build the team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM. What You’ll Be Doing Sitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need, the thing behind the thing they asked for, and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against. Being the connective tissue. Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions. jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it. While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 20k to € 200k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if: Y
